about_the_game:
🕯️ STORY

When darkness devours the last elven lands, a warrior named Xyrra rises from the shadows.
Her sister, heir to the ancient elven bloodline, has been captured by a demonic force and imprisoned deep within a mountain fortress.

Armed with twin blades and forbidden magic, Xyrra embarks on a perilous journey through four realms, from fading forests to fiery depths, to rescue her sister and confront the Demon Lord who shattered their world.

Light the torches. Sharpen your blades. The age of elves is not over yet.

⚔️ GAMEPLAY & FEATURES

  • Dynamic 2D combat – fluid sword fighting, kicks, slides, and ranged magic attacks.

  • Challenging boss battles – each realm hides a guardian corrupted by darkness.

  • Hand-drawn visuals – detailed 2D art with shifting color palettes that reflect the world’s decay.

  • Story-driven progression – uncover the fate of Xyrra’s family through dialogues and cinematic cutscenes.

  • Atmospheric soundtrack – epic, melancholic, and haunting melodies that evolve with your journey.

  • Simple yet deep controls – easy to learn, rewarding to master.

🌌 WORLD & SETTING

Explore four distinct realms – each hand-crafted with unique atmosphere and challenges:

🌲 Between the Woods – where the forest still whispers.
🪨 Stone Trail – a frozen path carved through the mountains.
❄️ Frosty Wind – snow and silence hide ancient ruins.
🔥 Torch and Sword – descend into the abyss where the dead still burn.
💀 No More Evil – face the Demon and decide the fate of the elven world.

🧝‍♀️ THE HERO – XYRRA

A dark elf warrior, forged by battle and loss.

  • Dual blades, magic spheres, and lightning reflexes.

  • Driven by love and vengeance.

  • Unbreakable even when the world collapses around her.

“I am fearless. I fight for her and for the light that still remains.”

🎵 INSPIRATIONS

If you enjoyed Hollow Knight, Blasphemous, or Ender Lilies, you’ll feel right at home in Mythica Adventures.
Our goal is to combine fast-paced combat, hand-drawn visuals, and emotional storytelling into one unforgettable dark fantasy experience.

💚 SUPPORT THE JOURNEY

Mythica Adventures is created by a small indie team driven by passion, not funding.
After an early crowdfunding attempt, we decided to move forward independently — and we’re bringing this world to life step by step.

Every wishlist helps us continue the journey.
💚 Add Mythica Adventures to your Wishlist and join our growing community.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 or AMD Equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i5 or AMD Equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: A dark fantasy 2D action-platformer. Play as Xyrra, a fearless dark elf warrior on a quest to save her sister from the Demon Lord. Explore five mystical realms, master fast combat, and fight through shadows to bring light back to the elven lands.
